verdict.rationale: Devin publishes an API reference section for integrating Devin into applications and automating workflows (docs-7, docs-8), and its llms.txt index lists a large API documentation set (probe-1). However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or includes runnable examples, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the standard paths (probe-3). Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground console, runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
